integrity: The proof is self-contained; the complete-bipartite specialization is checked against the cited 2006 theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts. The exhaustive verifier covers orders at most eight and is a stress test rather than the infinite proof. Residual originality risk remains for unindexed older literature on cographs or complete multipartite orderings.
title: Minimum-sum vertex cover on complete multipartite graphs
